## Type of change

- [ ] feat — new feature
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] docs — documentation only
- [ ] refactor — internal restructuring, no user-facing change
- [ ] perf — performance improvement
- [ ] test — tests only
- [ ] chore — tooling, deps, build

## Checklist

- [ ] Code compiles and `pnpm typecheck` is clean.
- [ ] `pnpm lint` and `pnpm format:check` are clean.
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `pnpm test` is green.
- [ ] Storybook story added/updated for any new component.
- [ ] MDX docs page added/updated for any new component.
- [ ] Subpath export added to `packages/ui/package.json` if a new component.
- [ ] Changeset added (`pnpm changeset`).
- [ ] No secrets committed; `.env` files not added.
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` respected if the change involves animation.
- [ ] Accessibility verified (axe-core clean, keyboard navigation works).
